rationale.conceptual: Standard DFT method (B3LYP with a common basis set) applied to small molecules; thermochemistry extraction is well‑documented. No new algorithm or deep derivation is needed.
rationale.execution: Multi‑stage pipeline: batch DFT calculations for many components, data fetching from NIST, intermediate CSV generation, and mole‑weighted mixture analysis. Requires orchestration of an open‑source DFT code, handling of multiple molecules, and dependency on external data, making it a moderately complex engineering task.

Resource needs are modest: CPU‑only, low memory per job, and negligible input data volume.
